_readme: THE ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH for which article is the current featured matchup of every sport. Every featured surface (each sport's Matchup of the Day door, the NFL Game of the Week door, /matchup-of-the-day/today/, the handicapping hub cards, the sportsbook strip) is baked from this file by scripts/featured_matchups.py and re-resolved in the browser by static/js/tmr-featured.js. A game stops being featured grace_minutes after its kickoff and the next one takes over by itself. Entries are added automatically: database Game Files by the Matchup of the Day bake, hand built pages by their own <meta name="tmr-featured"> tags on every sync. Never hand edit a door, card or strip. Set status to withdrawn to pull an entry.
